measurement: Scored the seven CQ SVGs with compare_svg_strict against the pre-registered tip predictions and against a render by the base binary. See probe-cq-score.txt.
observed: Java emits Menlo with no font-style and no font-weight, and every member width is the Menlo cell. Tip matches the class-name cell and mismatches both text nodes by adding italic, weight 700, and the Bold Italic fallback advance. Base also adds italic and weight 700, and its widths are not the Menlo cell. Tip 0/7, base 0/7.
cause: ValueImpl.asFontFace (159-178) returns UFontFace.normal() for any FontStyle other than bold, italic, plain, normal, or a CSS weight. The token bolditalic, and the two-word value bold italic, are both the normal face. Style.getUFont (209-212) then keeps that face unless a separate FontWeight has a CSS weight other than 400, in which case withWeight replaces only the weight and keeps the italic axis. The CQ sources set ClassFontStyle and ClassAttributeFontStyle to bolditalic. Rust ClassFontOverrides treats that string with contains("bold") and contains("italic"), so both flags become true, and mono_text_width_styled then measures the Bold Italic fallback table. The probes never reach Menlo Bold Italic in Java.
decision: The fallback table stays. The packet-caused path is the class FontStyle reader. Read ClassFontStyle, ClassAttributeFontStyle, and the class and header fontStyle properties with style_cascade::font_face, which already ports asFontFace. bold and italic stay one flag each. bolditalic and bold italic become the normal face, so these diagrams measure the Menlo cell and emit no italic or weight.
real_bold_italic: An abstract class member is the path both sides already compose. MethodsOrFieldsArea.createTextBlock (249-250) calls config.italic() after FontConfiguration.create from the class style. FontConfiguration.getFont (98-101) runs FontStyle.ITALIC.mutateFont, and withStyle(ITALIC) keeps the current weight. ClassAttributeFontStyle bold is weight 700, so an {abstract} member is Menlo Bold Italic. The class name inherits that bold weight and is not abstract, so the name stays Menlo Bold. Creole <b> then <i> is FontStyle.mutateFont as well, but class members are not measured through creole segments. Activity and sequence participant already call font_face, so a single bolditalic skinparam stays plain there. Neither reader applies FontWeight on top of FontStyle.
change: Switch the class FontStyle assignments that the CQ packet hits, and the class stereotype FontStyle reader beside them, from substring contains to font_face. Do not change text_render.rs. Do not change the fallback table.
residue: Sequence arrow font style still uses contains, so sequenceArrowFontStyle bolditalic still selects both flags. Class, sequence, and activity do not read FontWeight, so FontStyle italic plus FontWeight bold is Bold Italic in Java and italic-only in Rust. The next held-out uses ClassAttributeFontStyle bold and an abstract member, not that style pair.
